questions.question: Who was Akbar's father?
answer_explanations: Correct. The article states that Akbar succeeded his father, Humayun.
Incorrect. Babur was Akbar's grandfather, not his father.
Incorrect. Bairam Khan was Akbar's regent and guardian, not his father.
Incorrect. Timur was an ancestor of Akbar through his paternal line, not his father.

questions.question: On what date was Akbar born?
answer_explanations: Correct. The article states that Jalal ud-din Muhammad Akbar was born on 15 October 1542.
Incorrect. 27 October 1605 is Akbar's date of death.
Incorrect. 14 February 1556 is the date Akbar succeeded Humayun.
Incorrect. 5 November 1556 is the date of the Second Battle of Panipat.

questions.question: Where was Akbar born?
answer_explanations: Correct. The article states Akbar was born at the Rajput Fortress of Amarkot in Rajputana.
Incorrect. Kabul is where Akbar was brought up during Humayun's exile, not where he was born.
Incorrect. Delhi is not mentioned as Akbar's birthplace.
Incorrect. Agra is not mentioned as Akbar's birthplace.

questions.question: Who served as regent for the young Akbar?
answer_explanations: Correct. The article states Akbar succeeded his father under a regent, Bairam Khan.
Incorrect. Maham Anga was Akbar's foster mother, not his regent.
Incorrect. Adham Khan was Akbar's foster brother and a Mughal commander, not his regent.
Incorrect. Tardi Baig Khan was left as regent of Delhi, not as regent for Akbar.

questions.question: Which Rajput princess did Akbar marry?
answer_explanations: Correct. The article states Akbar married the Rajput princess Mariam-uz-Zamani.
Incorrect. Hamida Banu Begum was Akbar's mother.
Incorrect. Ruqaiya Sultan Begum was Akbar's betrothed and later wife, but she was Hindal Mirza's daughter, not described as the Rajput princess in this context.
Incorrect. Kamala Devi was sent to the Mughal harem after the conquest of Garha, not Akbar's wife.

questions.question: At what age was Akbar enthroned?
answer_explanations: Correct. The article states the 14-year-old Akbar was enthroned by Bairam Khan at Kalanaur.
Incorrect. Nine was Akbar's age when he was appointed governor of Ghazni, not when he was enthroned.
Incorrect. Eighteen was Akbar's age when he dismissed Bairam Khan, not when he was enthroned.
Incorrect. Twenty is not mentioned as Akbar's age at enthronement.

questions.question: In which year did Akbar succeed Humayun?
answer_explanations: Correct. The article states Akbar succeeded Humayun on 14 February 1556.
Incorrect. 1542 is Akbar's birth year.
Incorrect. 1605 is Akbar's death year.
Incorrect. 1555 is when Humayun reconquered Delhi, not when Akbar succeeded him.

questions.question: Who became the next Mughal emperor after Akbar?
answer_explanations: Correct. The article states their son, Jahangir, became the next Mughal emperor.
Incorrect. Humayun was Akbar's father and predecessor.
Incorrect. Babur was Akbar's grandfather.
Incorrect. Sikandar Shah Suri was a Sur ruler whom Akbar fought, not his successor.

questions.question: What title was Akbar proclaimed at his enthronement?
answer_explanations: Correct. The article states Akbar was proclaimed Shahanshah, Persian for "King of Kings".
Incorrect. Padshah is not mentioned as Akbar's proclaimed title.
Incorrect. Sultan is not mentioned as Akbar's proclaimed title.
Incorrect. Khan is not mentioned as Akbar's proclaimed title.

questions.question: Who was Akbar's mother?
answer_explanations: Correct. The article states Jalal ud-din Muhammad Akbar was born to Humayun and Hamida Banu Begum.
Incorrect. Mariam-uz-Zamani was Akbar's wife, not his mother.
Incorrect. Maham Anga was Akbar's foster mother, not his biological mother.
Incorrect. Qutlugh Nigar Khanum was Akbar's grandmother, Babur's wife.
